_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-host-adapters.cjs — do not edit; change the source and re-run. Source: the canonical Claude Code manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json -> mcpServers) — the one server list all hosts translate from. All 6 bundled servers, which is what a Cursor install gets by default. Cursor is community-reported to stop exposing tools past ~40 across all connected servers (unmeasured — M1A-VERIFY). If you hit that, switch to the priority profile in mcp.pruned.json, which keeps 4 servers and drops playwright, notion-mcp. Re-enabling a dropped server is a per-server toggle in Cursor Settings -> MCP, or a regeneration of this file; see the README section "Bundled MCP servers".
